title: Ron Pandolfi: breakthrough into 'the next world' in the desert

tellings.quote: He's been at the CI since 84. He's rumored to brief the presidents. And he says, quote, "People have always wondered what it's like to go into the next world. There's been a breakthrough." He looks over at this John guy. Next time John goes to the desert, a number of us here will go into the next world and come back again.

yeah well this where this tape from Ron because he didn't know it was going to be public. He had no idea that that I would grab this off the internet and grab it and he's definitely talking about portals
tellings.difference: Calls what Pandolfi describes portals, and says the tape was grabbed off the internet without Pandolfi knowing it would become public.
tellings.link_reason: Grant Cameron's tape of Pandolfi talking unguardedly matches the recorded Pandolfi remark about a breakthrough letting people go into 'the next world' in the desert and come back, which is in effect portal talk.

plain: A CIA man named Ron Pandolfi, said to have been at the agency since 1984 and rumored to brief presidents, is quoted saying there has been a breakthrough in going into "the next world," and that next time a man called John goes to the desert, several of them will go into the next world and come back. A researcher named Grant Cameron tells Michels this comes from a tape of Pandolfi that he grabbed off the internet, which Pandolfi never expected to be public. Cameron says Pandolfi is clearly talking about portals, and if so, it would mean people inside the CIA believe they can travel to another realm and return.
